rationale.complete: Round 1 is done over 35 periods with per-period verdicts, synthetic guards and a scorecard; the holdout predictions are drafted but not locked or run, and the room-aware and reply-vs-wake-up follow-ups are open.
rationale.faithfulness: Hawkes beats same-baseline Poisson and the fast cross term beats the agent-shift null (C = 1), but every mode and criticality prediction (P1-P6) failed and pooled n-hat is not identified against slow rate modulation.
rationale.usefulness: A branching ratio with a schedule baseline, plus a fast cross-excitation term, is a cascade-risk diagnostic anyone can compute on their own logs, and the constant-baseline pitfall is a concrete warning; the payoff beyond that is unclear.

one_line: Subcritical everywhere (n about 0.2-0.4), no coupling-mode effect; only fast cross-agent triggering beats nulls
